reviews.title: this used 4070 still packs a punch
reviews.comment: working well so far. replaced my old rtx 3060 ti with this 4070 and i've gotten roughly 50% better performance at 1440p. so glad it fit into my casing's limited space. it idles at around 45-55 degrees celcius at ambient temperate of around 28-30 degrees
reviews.author: CHEE MING YAU

reviews.title: Great deal if bought refurbished!
reviews.comment: This graphics card is great! It arrived on time, and I have had no issues over the month using it. The performance far exceeded what I imagined for this card. It is extremely quiet, and installation was easy.
reviews.author: Jordan C

reviews.title: Almost
reviews.comment: Other than UPS messing around with my order, the gpu came in near perfect condition, it’s quiet, the price was perfect for it being “used”. I have no complaints for the seller, just ups dancing around with my order. Definitely buying from these guys again.
